lines.zh: 拎着篮子穿过集市，避开人群。
lines.en: Basket in hand, I cross the market, dodging crowds.
I'm off to the well; it's not far.

lines.zh: 脚下的石阶被踩得很滑。
lines.en: The steps are worn smooth by feet.

lines.zh: 把篮子换个手，肩膀轻一点。
lines.en: I shift the basket to my other hand.

lines.zh: 绕过卖菌汤的摊子，香味太浓。
lines.en: I skirt the fungus-soup stall; the smell is strong.

lines.zh: 今天要送两袋谷物去东屋。
lines.en: Two sacks of grain to the east house today.

lines.zh: 我在窄巷里走，墙上有孩子的画。
lines.en: In the alley, children's drawings cover the wall.
I walk slowly; nobody's rushing me.

lines.zh: 遇到熟人点个头，不多说。
lines.en: I nod at a neighbor and say little.
The street lanterns need oil again.
The carrying pole sways at both ends.

lines.zh: 回家前绕去广场看一眼。
lines.en: Before home, I swing past the square.
I sit on the doorstep shelling beans.

lines.zh: 看炉子里的火，慢慢变小。
lines.en: I watch the hearth fire shrink.

lines.zh: 数屋檐下挂了几串干菌。
lines.en: I count the dried fungus strings under the eaves.

lines.zh: 把篮子里的东西摆整齐。
lines.en: I arrange the basket until it's neat.
I listen to the smith hammering far off.
Flour on my hands; I clap it off.
I lean in the doorway and watch the shadow move.

lines.zh: 想起小时候在广场追鸡。
lines.en: I think of chasing chickens in the square as a child.

lines.zh: 把凉了的汤重新热一遍。
lines.en: I warm the cold soup up again.
I squint and wait for the bell tower.

lines.zh: 你是走商？篮子里装什么？
lines.en: A trader? What's in your basket?

lines.zh: 别站在门口，我要关门了。
lines.en: Don't stand in the doorway; I'm closing up.
Your clothes; nobody here wears that.
If you need directions, ask; I'm busy.
Don't frighten the children; they're shy.

lines.zh: 你手上有铁锈，是从矿场来？
lines.en: Rust on your hands; from the mines?

lines.zh: 抬头，你踩着我家菜畦了。
lines.en: Look up; you're standing in my vegetable bed.

lines.zh: 外乡人，你会说我们的话。
lines.en: Outlander, and you speak our tongue.

lines.zh: 我不做买卖，你找错门了。
lines.en: I don't trade; wrong door.
You carry the smell of lava.

lines.zh: 篮子掉了，豆子滚了一地。
lines.en: The basket fell; beans rolled everywhere.

lines.zh: 我喊了一声，声音有点破。
lines.en: I cry out, and my voice cracks.
Stop; I've stopped hitting back.
My arm's numb; I can't lift it.

lines.zh: 血滴在围裙上，洗不掉了。
lines.en: Blood on my apron; it won't wash out.
I back toward the door, holding the wall.
That blow rattled my head.
Child, stay inside; shut the door.
My knees give, but I'm still up.
I've memorized your face.

lines.zh: 你那块面包，换我一篮菌。
lines.en: That bread of yours for a basket of fungus.
Gold nuggets? Can I eat those?

lines.zh: 给我一把种子，屋后有地。
lines.en: Give me seeds; there's soil behind the house.

lines.zh: 你的壶还有水吗？井水太咸。
lines.en: Any water in your flask? The well tastes foul.

lines.zh: 这匹布，够给孩子做件衣。
lines.en: This cloth would make the child a shirt.
Bring salt and I'll trade dried fungus.

lines.zh: 你手里的果子，是树上摘的？
lines.en: That fruit in your hand; picked from a tree?

lines.zh: 别拿金子晃我，我数不清。
lines.en: Don't wave gold at me; I can't count it.

lines.zh: 东西搁门口，我洗干净手再拿。
lines.en: Leave it at the door; I'll wash first.

lines.zh: 你要菌汤的方子？拿陶罐换。
lines.en: Want my soup recipe? Trade a clay jar.
Sorry; my basket's in the way.
Easy; the soup will spill.
Only one fits through this alley.
You bumped me; the beans scattered.
Let me pass first; the pot is hot.
Don't push; the lamp's on the wall.

lines.zh: 篮子底破了，帮我捡一下。
lines.en: My basket's torn; help me pick things up.
You're on my heel.
What's the rush? The market's still early.

lines.zh: 退半步，我把扁担横过来。
lines.en: Step back; I'll turn the pole sideways.
Tonight I'll cook one extra bowl.
You sort the greens; I tend the fire.
The roof leaks; we'll patch it tomorrow.

lines.zh: 孩子睡了，我们小声说话。
lines.en: The child's asleep; let's talk softly.

lines.zh: 这袋谷子分你一半带回去。
lines.en: Take half this grain home with you.
Your hands are cold; hold on a while.
Next year we'll break new soil behind the house.
You've worked all day; sit and rest.
Knock the wall if you need me.

lines.zh: 这盏灯给你，路上亮一点。
lines.en: Take this lamp; the road will be brighter.
The beans spilled; I crouch and pick them up.

lines.zh: 谁掉的铜板，我放窗台上。
lines.en: Someone's coin; I'll leave it on the sill.
This bit of rope is still good; into the basket.

lines.zh: 菜叶掉了，拂掉土还能吃。
lines.en: A dropped leaf; brush off the dirt, still edible.
I pick up the doll the child dropped.
This bowl is cracked; a shame.

lines.zh: 把落下的果子放回篮子。
lines.en: I put the fallen fruit back in the basket.

lines.zh: 地上的炭渣，扫起来还能烧。
lines.en: Coal scraps on the floor still burn; I sweep them.

lines.zh: 捡到一封信，我送去东屋。
lines.en: A letter; I'll carry it to the east house.
I can't bend, so I squat to gather it.
Someone's prying at my window.
The chickens are raising the wrong alarm.

lines.zh: 巷口那个人，来回走了三趟。
lines.en: That one at the alley mouth has passed three times.

lines.zh: 他把手伸进邻居的筐里。
lines.en: He's reaching into a neighbor's basket.

lines.zh: 影子压在门缝上，不动了。
lines.en: A shadow stops at the door crack.
My child is still out in the yard.
He's carrying off my clay jar.
Someone's over the wall; tiles fell.

lines.zh: 他朝粮仓去了，脚步很急。
lines.en: He's heading for the granary, walking fast.
Someone pulled the torch from our gate.
He ignores the goods and studies the locks.
The neighbor's dog won't stop barking.

lines.zh: 他手里拿着我家的钥匙。
lines.en: He's holding our house key.
The street went quiet; too quiet.
I grab the hoe from behind the door.
Shout for help first, then block the door.

lines.zh: 别让他进院子，孩子在里面。
lines.en: Don't let him past the yard; the child's inside.
I brace the carrying pole across the doorway.
He moves left; I shift left.
Blow out the lamp and he can't see.
Fall back to the hearth; there's hot water.

lines.zh: 记住他的靴子，回头报官。
lines.en: Remember his boots and report it later.

lines.zh: 等他进门再动手，别在街上。
lines.en: Wait till he's inside, not in the street.
Guard the grain sacks; forget the jars.
I drop the bar; my hands are shaking.
He glances back; I freeze.
Give ground so he thinks nobody's home.
I count his steps and wait for the third.
The hoe lands on his shoulder, weakly.
I jab the pole into his chest.

lines.zh: 热水泼出去，他退了一步。
lines.en: I throw the hot water; he steps back.
That swing missed; my hands shook.
Stay back; I've threshed grain before.
I throw a jar; it shatters on him.
He grabs the pole and we wrestle.
I drive a knee into his leg.

lines.zh: 把他推出门，别在屋里打。
lines.en: Shove him outside; not in the house.
Only a broom at hand, so I swing it.
He let go; I back away.

lines.zh: 这一巴掌是替孩子打的。
lines.en: This slap is for my child.
I shout for help, loud enough.
When I can't swing more, I block the door.
Before dawn, I'm up to light the fire.

lines.zh: 推开窗，外面的摊子还没摆。
lines.en: I open the shutters; the stalls aren't set yet.

lines.zh: 篮子在门边，今天要赶集。
lines.en: The basket's by the door; market day today.

lines.zh: 屋檐滴着水，昨夜下过雨？
lines.en: The eaves are dripping; did it rain last night?

lines.zh: 邻居家的烟先冒起来了。
lines.en: The neighbor's chimney smokes before mine.

lines.zh: 我把米倒进缸里，数了数。
lines.en: I pour the rice into the jar and count.
The village is unusually quiet today.

lines.zh: 孩子还在睡，我放轻脚步。
lines.en: The child's asleep; I tread softly.

lines.zh: 广场的钟还没敲第一下。
lines.en: The square bell hasn't rung once yet.
Someone left a sack of grain at the door.
I tie my apron and start sorting greens.

lines.zh: 井绳换了新的，摸着粗糙。
lines.en: New well rope; it feels rough in my hands.
My sleeve caught fire; I roll on the floor.

lines.zh: 从梯子上摔下来，篮子翻了。
lines.en: I fall from the ladder; the basket tips over.

lines.zh: 井水灌进鼻子，我抓绳子。
lines.en: Well water fills my nose; I grab the rope.

lines.zh: 窗纸全碎了，耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The shutters blew in; my ears are ringing.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我家门板上。
lines.en: An arrow's stuck in my door.
My body feels weighted down by something.
My stomach's empty and I can't stand steady.

lines.zh: 雷劈在钟楼上，我跪下了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the bell tower; I dropped to my knees.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，篮子先掉了。
lines.en: No ground under me; the basket falls first.
